description: This file contains the implementation of a database-backed session handler class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It provides methods to read, write, delete, and clean up session data stored in a database table.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A class that manages session data stored in a database, providing methods for reading, writing, deleting, and garbage collecting sessions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DB session handler with dependencies from the registry, such as the database connection and configuration.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Retrieves session data from the database for a given session ID if it has not expired.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in the database with an expiration timestamp.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the session data associated with a specific session ID.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection to remove expired sessions based on probabilistic trigger.
